mapper.select: SELECT SDA.* FROM SMT_DEVICE_TASK SDA join SMT_DEVICE device on sda.DEVICE_CODE=device.ID WHERE NVL(SDA.STATUS, 0) = 0 AND SDA.OVER_TIME > #{overTime} AND SDA.START_TIME < #{overTime} AND (SDA.ACTION = 1 or SDA.ACTION = 3) AND SDA.DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType} AND NVL(SDA.CODE, -1) != 200 and device.CONNECT_STATUS=2 ORDER BY SDA.TIMES ASC

SELECT SDA.* FROM SMT_DEVICE_TASK SDA join SMT_DEVICE device on sda.DEVICE_CODE=device.ID WHERE NVL(SDA.STATUS, 0) = 0 AND SDA.OVER_TIME > #{overTime} AND SDA.START_TIME < #{overTime} AND (SDA.ACTION = 11 or SDA.ACTION = 13) AND SDA.DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType} AND NVL(SDA.CODE, -1) != 200 and device.CONNECT_STATUS=2 ORDER BY SDA.TIMES ASC

SELECT SDA.* FROM SMT_DEVICE_TASK SDA join SMT_DEVICE device on sda.DEVICE_CODE=device.ID WHERE SDA.STATUS = 0 AND SDA.ACTION = 2 AND SDA.OVER_TIME < #{overTime} AND SDA.DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType} AND NVL(SDA.CODE, -1) != 200 and device.CONNECT_STATUS=2 ORDER BY SDA.TIMES ASC

SELECT SDA.* FROM SMT_DEVICE_TASK SDA join SMT_DEVICE device on sda.DEVICE_CODE=device.ID WHERE SDA.STATUS = 0 AND SDA.ACTION = 12 AND SDA.OVER_TIME < #{overTime} AND SDA.DEVICE_TYPE = #{deviceType} AND NVL(SDA.CODE, -1) != 200 and device.CONNECT_STATUS=2 ORDER BY SDA.TIMES ASC
SELECT SDA.ID, SDA.DEVICE_TYPE FROM SMT_DEVICE_TASK SDA WHERE SDA.DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} AND SDA.CARD_NO= #{cardNo} AND (SDA.STATUS = 0 OR SDA.STATUS = 1 OR SDA.STATUS = 3) ORDER BY SDA.ID ASC
